business_problem: BMC Helix needed to help enterprise IT teams identify and recover from incidents faster by moving beyond simple assistive features into autonomous ServiceOps agents that customers could securely deploy in their own cloud environments.
solution_summary: BMC Helix built an autonomous ServiceOps framework on Gemini platform using Llama models to power agents such as Ops Swarmer. Gemini platform provides the managed environment in which BMC can fine-tune and run these models quickly, while the company’s custom mixture-of-experts architecture keeps the system lightweight enough to run efficiently on limited GPU resources. The resulting agents reason, plan, and assist engineers directly inside chat workflows, giving operations teams more relevant incident context and actionable suggestions. Because the framework is designed for customer cloud environments, enterprise users in industries such as financial services and telecom can deploy fine-tuned models without giving up control over their infrastructure. This architecture turned agentic AI into an operational reliability tool, helping BMC customers reduce recovery times for mission-critical services while creating a portable ServiceOps foundation they can extend in their own environments.
